description: Return a list of complete US street-address suggestions for partial input, intended for type-ahead / autocomplete fields. Use while a user is typing an address and you want to offer full matches. For city-only suggestions use sthan_autocomplete_city; for ZIP-only suggestions use sthan_autocomplete_zipcode; to validate a finished address use sthan_verify_address. Read-only with no side effects. Requires a sthan.io API key in STHAN_API_KEY; each call counts toward your plan's rate limit (a free tier is available). On failure it returns an error message.

text.description: Partial address text (3+ characters recommended). Example: '123 Main'

name: sthan_autocomplete_address
title: Autocomplete US Address
